task.description:
Implement design section 10 of lib/letflow/design/iss0113-tenant-fixture-sandbox-restore-opt-in.md (CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR PASSed it with zero BLOCKERs -- handoffs/WF03-ISS0480-20260905/step-02b-code-design-validator.json). Read section 10 in full (subsections 10.0-10.7) before writing any code -- it is the normative source for every module/config/signature you create. Do NOT re-derive the design yourself; implement exactly what section 10.3's normative subsections (10.3.1-10.3.4) specify, and resolve section 10.7's open questions using your own engineering judgement where they are flagged as implementer-discretion (naming/organization choices with no behavior difference) -- they are explicitly NOT ambiguous about WHAT ships, only about minor implementation choices.

Summary of what ships (full detail is in the design, this is not a substitute for reading it): a new test-only Ecto.Repo module (Letflow.Test.ProvisioningRepo per the design's naming) with its own pool/adapter config, and `Letflow.TenantFixture.provisioned_tenant!/1` changed so its Sandbox.mode/2 call targets this new repo instead of Letflow.Repo -- via Ecto.Repo.put_dynamic_repo/1, exactly as section 10.3.2's seam describes. `provisioned_tenant!/1`'s public @spec, opts() type, and return shape must NOT change (CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR independently confirmed this is the design's own claim and it is checkable -- verify it stays true after your own edit, not just before). Zero edits to any of the 46 existing call sites. config/test.exs gets a new sibling config block per 10.3.4. scripts/test_parallel.sh's TEST_POOL_SIZE formula is extended by the fixed PROVISIONING_POOL_SIZE=2 term per 10.2.2/10.3.4 -- do not accidentally make this term core-count-derived; the design and CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR's independent arithmetic both depend on it staying a FIXED constant.

Open question 10.7 OQ-6 (application_name tag interaction with ISS-0110's TenantSchemaReaper liveness guard) requires you to check test/support/tenant_schema_reaper.ex's actual source before finalizing the new repo's connection config -- do not skip this; a wrongly-tagged or untagged new pool's connections could either falsely trigger or fail to trigger ISS-0110's own concurrent-invocation guard, which would be a regression against an already-resolved issue, not a new defect but a real regression risk this open question exists to head off.

After implementing: compile clean (`mix compile --warnings-as-errors`), and run the scoped set of tests this change can plausibly affect (test/support/tenant_fixture_test.exs, test/support/tenant_fixture_dispatch_test.exs, test/letflow/row_approval_test.exs, test/letflow/definitions/pack_update_migration_test.exs, and at least 2-3 of the 46 TenantFixture-calling test files including the 2 already-async ones) before handing to REVIEWER -- do not wait for TEST-DESIGNER's regression test to be the first signal something is broken. This is Unblock-Everything territory (core-directives.md): if your own implementation reveals a design gap CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR's static read couldn't have caught, report it in result.issues and consider whether it needs a rework note back to CODE-DESIGNER (do not silently patch around a real design gap).

SECURITY-REVIEWER note: this touches test-support infrastructure only (test/support/, config/test.exs, scripts/test_parallel.sh) -- no lib/letflow/ production code, no migration, no tenant-data API path. State plainly in your own result whether you believe this is in or out of SECURITY-REVIEWER's scope so ORCH can route correctly; do not assume out-of-scope without stating the reasoning (core-directives.md's Instruction Precedence: a safety/gate rule is never silently skipped).
acceptance_criteria: Letflow.Test.ProvisioningRepo (or design-specified equivalent name) created exactly per section 10.3.1's normative signature

provisioned_tenant!/1's Sandbox.mode/2 call redirected via put_dynamic_repo/1 per section 10.3.2, with default dynamic repo correctly restored to Letflow.Repo afterward (per the design's own 3-wrap-point requirement, OQ-7)
provisioned_tenant!/1's public @spec, opts() type, and return shape verified unchanged after the edit (re-check this yourself, don't assume)
Zero edits to any of the 46 existing TenantFixture call sites
config/test.exs and scripts/test_parallel.sh updated per sections 10.3.4/10.2.2, PROVISIONING_POOL_SIZE kept as a fixed constant (=2), not core-count-derived

OQ-6 (ISS-0110 TenantSchemaReaper application_name tag interaction) explicitly checked against tenant_schema_reaper.ex's real source before finalizing connection config, and the finding stated in result.summary
A scoped test run (tenant_fixture tests, the two ISS-0480 victim files, several TenantFixture-calling files) run and reported with real output before handoff to REVIEWER
Explicit statement of whether this change is in/out of SECURITY-REVIEWER's scope, with reasoning
